comments.value: I have fixed my issue, about 12 hours prior I setup a custom config for yt-dlp in my appdata and I guess that it was interfering with the yt-dlp that vrc uses itself causing issues. (My custom config was telling yt-dlp where to find my ffmpeg, where to download completed files and to set audio to flac).

details:
Yesterday I was sitting at a music event enjoying the stream and then decided to go to another world to watch a movie or something. Except everything I clicked the bar would go to 1/3 then immediately return "Invalid URL" so I tried pasting some urls I know would work but same issue. I have tried every potential fix I can find by searching around, the help.vrchat site and asking in discord.
So that is: Turning off "Allow untrusted URLS" restarting client then turning back on and restarting, Re-installing the game, Completely clearing cache + profile data + settings, Completely removing all folders when uninstalling. Checking certificates which is a 'fix' on the help.vrchat page thing (of which none were found issued to google), Resetting 3D settings some said worked on Nvidia Control Panel, Restarting my PC, Resetting my router.
But none of it is working at all, I turned my computer off for the night, woke up today and still the same issue, I have tried again going to a music event that is streamed but nothing, no videos working in worlds still either. They work perfectly fine in browser (twitch and youtube for example).
title: Video's not loading at all suddenly upon world change.
